metadata.title: Careers & Job Opportunities | PT Autentik Karya Analitika
metadata.description: Explore job opportunities at PT Autentik Karya Analitika through the official recruitment portal.

hero.title: Build Your Future With Us
hero.description: Explore career opportunities in instrumentation technology, IoT, software engineering, and technical sales. We invite dedicated talent to grow with us.

culture.title: Why Build Your Career Here?
culture.description: We believe innovation grows through healthy collaboration, recognition of contributions, and room for everyone to develop.
culture.innovationDescription: Work directly with modern technologies: IoT, Next.js, industrial sensors, and high-precision data analytics.
culture.teamDescription: A supportive work environment, open communication without rigid bureaucracy, and encouragement to progress together.
culture.careerDescription: Transparent performance reviews, mentoring programmes, and budget support for professional certification and training.
culture.welfareDescription: Competitive compensation, comprehensive BPJS coverage, flexible/hybrid working hours, and regular recognition.
